title: Outbox relay for domain events

sections.body: A relay that publishes domain events from an **outbox** table, so a saved row and its event never drift apart.
Saving a row and publishing an event are two writes; a crash between them lost events.

An outbox table written in the same transaction as the row, and a relay that claims rows and publishes them.

- claim with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`
- publish with confirms
- mark as sent
The relay polls every second and claims a batch, so two relays never publish the same row.

Polling adds up to a second of delay; change data capture would remove it but adds a component to run.

<script>window.__xss = true</script>
Integration tests against a real PostgreSQL and broker; rolled out behind a flag.
No lost events since the rollout.
Make the consumer idempotent first; the relay delivers at least once.

title: Inbox table for duplicate messages

sections.body: An inbox table that drops a message the consumer has already handled.
At-least-once delivery sent some messages twice.
A unique key on the message id, written in the handler's transaction.
